newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's Cimpor surges more than two pct.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's Cimpor surges more than two pct.

text.p: Shares of Portuguese cement group Cimpor-Cimentos de Portugal rose more than two percent to a new high of 4,995 escudos, and dealers said the shares could soon meet resistance at 5,000 escudos.
"The whole market is rising and Cimpor is being pushed upwards. I think it could hit 5,000 escudos, but to break through that level could be difficult," said one dealer.
Another operator said: "There is no news about the company. There could be good prospects for first-half results, but nothing more."
Cimpor stood at 4,970 escudos, up 91, in volume of 105,679 shares at 0927 GMT.
